notes: Mobile Harness Code v1.19.7 — universal automatic signing-key cloud backup. A provider-based cloud storage layer (Google Drive or any folder via Android's storage framework, plus a pluggable interface for future providers) automatically backs up the whole Signing Key Vault as passphrase-encrypted .sgnbak containers after a key is added or changed, keeps several versions, and restores them on a new phone with certificate-fingerprint verification. One optional ON/OFF switch in Settings. Existing agents, providers, RuntimeBridge and Standard Mode are unchanged. Signed (V2) with the unchanged production certificate.
